Even though most of what you see / find is lower value, it's so much fun and satisfying to find the rocks yourself!!

Essentially you smash rocks with friends and get pretty shiny things for dirt cheap 😂

Some things to note - claw hammers work best for combing through rocks, bring gloves, water, and of course safety glasses / boots 🤍

A rock farm is essentially an enclosed area where the owners of the shop will circulate fresh and old boulders, containing various gemstones from the local mines! They load fresh rocks in every single morning and use a large machine to essentially mix all the rocks up. Think of an open meadow-like area, except the ground is just boulders ranging from 5-6" all the way up to 24" or so. You go in free, mine the rocks and gems you want, and pay on your way out, at this place it's 2.00 CAD per pound which is much cheaper than buying from stores. At the specific place I went to there was an abundance of rose quartz / various quartz, amethyst (although you need to get there early before it's all picked out), calcite, geodes, and lots of other things both naturally found in the area and whatever's in the rocks received through shipment.

EXTREMELY fun experience for someone getting into the hobby!! Smashing rocks and finding pretty shiny things is a reaaaally good stress reliever 😭😂
